title: Assets
slide_intent: Connect instructions with their production resources so partners can find the intended files instead of reconstructing them from examples.
strategic_value: A grouped asset directory can reduce divergence between Uber’s guide and the files used by partner teams.
demonstration: Five underlined Google Drive links are grouped under Logo Assets, Logo Product Lockups, Logo Partnership Lockups, Color Assets and Typography Assets.
practical_value: Identify the asset family needed for a job; treat the historical links as pointers, not as files supplied with this archive.

content_islands.name: Assets heading
content_islands.spec: Place the heading at the upper left.

content_islands.name: Asset directory
content_islands.spec: Stack the five bold asset labels and their underlined URLs down the left side; retain the open right half.

reference_purposes.Application: The directory routes partners to five named production-asset categories through Google Drive links.
